thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: Reserved capacity pool 'resv-pool-eu-2' (enterprise tenants) reporting GPU saturation and queue growth. GPU util 98%, queue length 312, autoscaler error: reached max_nodes=10. Incident ID INC-2026-4598. @oncall
katie: ack — oncall here, looking into it now.
ryan: jumping in, give me 2m to pull metrics and recent autoscaler logs.
eliot: seeing tail latency spikes and high KV-cache churn on the pool. Could be a noisy tenant spiking long-running inference loops.
katie: @ryan can you confirm noisy neighbor vs genuine customer surge? also ping @marco-cs to prep customer comms for the impacted enterprise (LumenPay).
ryan: running query: `select tenant, avg(gpu_util), running_tasks from gpu_metrics where pool='resv-pool-eu-2' group by tenant order by avg(gpu_util) desc limit 6;`
ryan: top result: tenant 'lumen-analytics' avg_gpu=95%, running_tasks=42. LumenPay (reserved) avg_gpu=92% but has many queued requests blocked behind those tasks.
eliot: that matches KV churn + long step durations. We have an eviction policy `evict-noisy` that can target non-reserved tenants occupying reserved nodes.
katie: mitigation plan A (immediate): evict noisy sessions for lumen-analytics, monitor queue. Plan B (if queue persists): temporarily increase autoscaler max nodes for this pool. Agree?
ryan: agree. executing eviction: ```orchctl evict --pool resv-pool-eu-2 --tenant lumen-analytics --grace 30s --reason "noisy-neighbor causing reserved pool saturation"``` 
ops-bot: [action] eviction started: 6 sessions targeted (ids: 0x3a7b,0x4b2c,0x5f9d,0x6e1a,0x7d2e,0x8c0f).
jordan: observe queue drop: 312 -> 68 within ~40s after eviction started.
marco-cs: pinged LumenPay CSM (Anna) with a heads-up; she's on the call and acknowledged.
katie: good. Next step: request infra to bump autoscaler hard limit for the pool from 10 -> 14 for a 20m window while we stabilize. @ryan can you make the change and monitor node attach?
ryan: raising a short-lived override: `autoscaler.override.set --pool resv-pool-eu-2 --max_nodes 14 --ttl 20m` -> applied. provisioning +6 nodes initiated, approx 90-150s to become available.
eliot: nodes are provisioning, kernels warming. provisioning latency ~120s observed in logs.
ops-bot: scaling event: +6 nodes attached. New pool util ~76% across nodes. Queue trending down to 14.
katie: monitor for 15m. If queue >50 for 10m, execute plan C: route LumenPay to a fallback smaller model variant to protect latency.
ryan: logs show a persistent heavy job from lumen-analytics that does multi-pass decoding; opened ENG-Runtime ticket to add tenant-level fair-share and detect multi-pass anomalies.
marco-cs: LumenPay reports improved response times; they request a post-incident summary and ask about possible SLA credits.
katie: create incident follow-up and assign to oncall-sre for RCA. Action items: 1) implement tenant fair-share throttles, 2) tune eviction thresholds (auto-evict when non-reserved consumes >60% for 2m), 3) review autoscaler headroom per reserved pool, 4) customer comms & SLA review.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED: incident_id=INC-2026-4598 status=mitigated severity=high postmortem_required=true
katie: thanks team — I'll continue to monitor for 30m and then hand off to night on-call. Adding notes to the incident ticket with commands used and metric snapshots.
ryan: leaving detailed runbook steps in the ticket (eviction command, override command, query results).
eliot: reassigning long-term fix to eng-runtime (fair-share + early eviction heuristics).
katie: handoff to @alex-night at ts=6478524200 for night coverage.
alex-night: ack — taking over. I'll watch the pool and follow the action items in the ticket.
